messages.subject: Rattle Updates: v5.2.7 : bug fixes, container, mlhub
messages.subject_clean: Rattle Updates: v5.2.7 : bug fixes, container, mlhub
messages.body_plain:
A couple of recent bug fixes have resolved issues with loading rattle projects and exporting PMML models.

To install the latest development Version 5.2.7 dated 2019-04-07:

> install.packages("rattle", repos="https://rattle.togaware.com", type="source")

The docker image for Rattle has also been updated to this latest version:

    https://hub.docker.com/r/kayon/rattle

My latest project is to create a repository of pre-built machine learning models (and more).
It is hosted on https://mlhub.ai and a docker image for it is also available as

    https://hub.docker.com/r/kayon/mlhub

Regards,
Graham
